declaration.preface: Cherry Hill Interiors Pvt. Ltd. is a prominent provider of occupancy solutions across India, specializing in corporate office interiors, healthcare facilities, and hospitality projects. Our operations are guided by strict compliance with legal and regulatory frameworks, ensuring fairness in business dealings and promoting responsible corporate behavior. Through proactive measures, continuous training, and ethical governance, we strengthen trust among employees, clients, and stakeholders. Our commitment to ethical business practices is rooted in integrity, transparency, and accountability. We strive to prevent corruption, fraud, conflicts of interest, and unethical conduct while ensuring compliance with all legal and regulatory requirements. By fostering a culture of honesty, fairness, and respect, we integrate responsible business conduct into our operations, promoting trust and ethical excellence across our stakeholder network.
declaration.declaration: Ethical responsibility and inclusivity form the foundation of Cherry Hill Interiors Pvt. Ltd.’s workplace culture. With Year 2022 as the baseline year for all our targets, we ensure adherence to ethical business practices, compliance with legal and industry standards, and responsible stakeholder engagement. Through governance, training, and collaboration, we continuously strengthen our ethical business conduct.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all business operations, including office spaces, project sites, supply chains, and interactions with stakeholders. It extends to employees, contractors, suppliers, and partners engaged in our business activities.

Strengthening Fraud Prevention and Detec: Maintain strict implementation of zero-tolerance policy for fraudulent behavior with clear disciplinary measures and enforcement protocols.
Enhance internal controls and financial oversight mechanisms to prevent, detect, and mitigate fraudulent activities.
Preventing Money Laundering and Financia: Strengthen financial monitoring systems to detect and report suspicious transactions in accordance with regulatory guidelines.
Ensure compliance with anti-money laundering (AML) regulations through continuous updates and mandatory training for relevant teams.
Strengthening Information Security and D: Ensure strict implementation of advanced cybersecurity measures to safeguard sensitive business, employee, and client data from breaches.
Regularly update IT security protocols to address evolving cyber threats and ensure compliance with industry best practices.
Conduct annual employee training on data privacy, phishing prevention, and cybersecurity risk management.

policy.monitoring:
At Cherry Hill, Ethical Conduct practices are continuously enhanced to stay aligned with evolving regulations, industry standards, and emerging risks. A strong culture of integrity is embedded across all levels of the organization, ensuring transparency, accountability, and regulatory compliance.

Ongoing Training & Awareness: Cherry Hill conducts regular ethics, anti-corruption, AML, fraud prevention, and data protection training for employees and relevant external stakeholders. Training programs are updated periodically to reflect regulatory changes, emerging risks, and lessons learned from internal reviews and incidents.

Risk Assessments & Independent Audits: Periodic ethics and compliance risk assessments are carried out to identify potential vulnerabilities related to corruption, fraud, conflicts of interest, money laundering, and information security. Independent internal and external audits are used to validate controls, verify compliance, and recommend improvements.

Collaborative Compliance Engagement: Partnerships with internal and external stakeholders strengthen ethical standards and compliance through structured assessments, engagement, and continuous improvement actions.

Advanced Monitoring & Reporting Systems: The company maintains systems to monitor high-risk transactions, compliance indicators, incidents, and policy adherence. Key metrics are reviewed regularly by management to ensure early detection of risks, timely response, and continuous strengthening of controls.

Feedback & Transparency Culture: Cherry Hill encourages open feedback, ethical dialogue, and reporting of concerns without fear of retaliation. Whistleblowing and grievance mechanisms are promoted actively, and aggregated findings and improvements are communicated transparently to reinforce trust and accountability.

Reporting Mechanism: Employees, suppliers, and stakeholders can report suspected violations through the confidential whistleblower system. Reports may be anonymous and are handled with strict confidentiality to prevent retaliation.

Investigation & Disciplinary Actions: The Compliance Officer investigates all reports, involving internal teams or external auditors as needed. Violators face disciplinary actions, including warnings, suspension, termination, or legal proceedings. Suppliers found in breach may face contract suspension or blacklisting.

Corrective & Preventive Actions: Remedial measures, such as process improvements, additional training, or stronger controls, are implemented to prevent recurrence. Findings from major breaches inform future risk assessments to strengthen policy enforcement.

Protection from Retaliation: Retaliation against any individual who reports concerns in good faith or participates in an investigation is strictly prohibited. Any act of retaliation will be treated as a serious policy violation and subject to disciplinary action.
policy.reviewMechanism:
The Ethics Officer reviews this policy once after every two years or earlier in response to regulatory changes, emerging risks, or operational needs.

Findings from risk assessments, internal audits, employee feedback, and reported ethical concerns are evaluated to enhance policy effectiveness.

Necessary revisions are implemented, and updated policies are communicated to all employees, suppliers, and relevant stakeholders to ensure continued compliance and awareness.
